outcome_detail: Ken Paxton won the 2026 Texas Republican U.S. Senate primary runoff with 63.8% of the vote vs. John Cornyn's ~36.2% (of ~1.38M votes cast), a margin of victory of approximately 27.6 percentage points. The AP called the race for Paxton shortly after 8 p.m. on May 26, 2026.
source_label: Houston Public Media (AP) — Ken Paxton cruises to big win against incumbent Sen. John Cornyn in Texas GOP primary runoff (May 26, 2026)
reasoning: Paxton won at 63.8% to Cornyn's ~36.2%, a margin of ~27.6 points. The market YES requires Paxton win AND margin >= 20 (bracket 20-100). 27.6 >= 20, so YES. Margin corroborated across Texas Tribune, NBC News, CNN, Ballotpedia, Al Jazeera, PBS, and Wikipedia, all citing Paxton 63.8% / ~64% of the vote.
